jordan: Quick heads-up — sprint cutover tomorrow 2026-03-24 09:00 UTC. We're introducing a change to the builder eviction policy to reduce noisy preemption during dense jobs. Please read the rollout notes below and flag any blockers.

jordan: Key points:
- Quiet window: 08:30-10:30 UTC (no large migrations or schema changes).
- Eviction threshold moves from 0.95 -> 0.85.
- Grace period for spot reclaim set to 120s.
- Canary starts at 10% traffic for 30m, then 50% for 1h before full flip.

release-czar: Adding to the release calendar and sending an all-eng blurb. :calendar:

ashley: What does this mean for Dedicated customers? Any SLA implications?

jordan: No SLA downgrade planned — this targets builder autoscaler behavior only. For Dedicated inference nodes we won't touch eviction thresholds unless you opt in. If you see tail latencies rise, tag me and we'll revert canary.

samir: I'll own the canary ramp. Plan to start with staging push at 08:45 then prod canary at 09:00. Command I'll use: `rctl canary set --service=builder-pool --percent=10`

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: staging rollout scheduled: 2026-03-24T08:45:00Z — job id: dpl-20260324-0814

maya: @samir thanks — I'll monitor allocator metrics and KV cache hit rate. :thumbsup:

ashley: If rollback is needed, what's the fastest path?

jordan: Rollback steps (fastest):
1) `rctl canary set --service=builder-pool --percent=0`
2) `rctl config apply --file=eviction-prev.yaml`
3) Abort in-flight scaleups: `kubectl scale --namespace infra deployment/builder --replicas=<prev>`
If you can't reach me, @release-czar or @samir will execute.

release-czar: Will prepare a short incident template for the on-call to use if we see regressions. I'll also add a line to the weekly changelog about the eviction policy change.

jordan: Thanks all. If anything urgent pops up overnight DM me. Otherwise we'll follow the quiet-window ops runbook and post updates in this thread during the rollout.
